France's plan to double army reservists in four years (s26, 19 Nov) adds to Poland's paid reservist training and Germany's reservist exercises.
patterns.unsaid: The steady paying and training of reservists across several states is consistent with governments treating a larger war in Europe as a planning case, while saying in public mainly that they are countering hybrid threats. A single-source report of a Russian sabotage plot in Poland (Ukrainska Pravda, 18 Nov) has not been confirmed elsewhere.
patterns.plain_explanation: Most of these are multi-year reserve and defence-spending programmes set after 2022, and Germany says its recruitment target is met without conscription. Reservist pay and training are routine budget items.

recent.text: A deal that reopens Hormuz within two weeks looks unlikely: Iran attaches conditions, and Trump is still floating strikes on nuclear sites.

recent.text: The Abu Dhabi round on Nov 10-11 ending without a ceasefire deal
